subject: Committee conclusion: candidate disposition & headcount redirect (Req-142)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Req-142 candidate: panel notes & request to convene committee

Team —

Thanks for taking the time to interview Olivia Chen last week. I pulled together the panel scorecard and the consolidated notes (attached). High level: technical loop was borderline for the senior bar (uneven systems design depth + limited production ML infra experience), but culture/leadership signals were strong. Compensation expectation is $220k total comp; current band for Req-142 tops at $200k.

Given the split signals I'd like to convene the hiring committee for a short call to decide whether we:
- extend an offer at band ceiling and a strong IC expectation, or
- close this candidate and reallocate the headcount to the next prioritized req (data infra), or
- approve a one-time band exception if leadership thinks it's strategic.

Please skim the attached scorecard before we meet. Proposed time: 2027-05-16 9:30am PT (30m). If that doesn't work, flag alternate times.

Attachments: req142_interview_scorecard.pdf, req142_panel_notes.docx

Thanks —
Aditya
Staff Recruiter (on behalf of Hiring Manager)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req-142 candidate: panel notes & request to convene committee

Aditya —

I reviewed the notes. My read: candidate would add value to product thinking and partner cross-functionally, but there are gaps vs. the senior IC expectations around scale and production ML systems (their caching/serving examples were academic, not operational).

If we stretch the band, we risk setting a precedent for other hires. I recommend we either:
1) Close this candidate and move the approved headcount to the prioritized data infra req (higher ROI this quarter), or
2) If the hiring manager wants to push, require a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to specific delivery milestones and escrowed partial equity.

I can join a quick call to formalize.

—Marissa
Director, Talent Acquisition

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req-142 candidate: panel notes & request to convene committee

Team —

Thanks for the notes and the thoughtful options. After speaking with the hiring manager and reviewing the scorecard, I'm recommending we close the loop on Req-142 without an offer. Rationale:
- Technical gaps on production infra are material for the role's immediate roadmap (low tolerance for ramp time).
- Compensation band push would create a precedent; we need to preserve band integrity while we finalize the new compensation calibration exercise.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Sending an outreach email to the candidate to decline politely and preserve the relationship for future fits. Aditya, can you handle the candidate message?
2) Reallocate the approved Req-142 headcount to Req-150 (Data Reliability Engineer) this quarter; Laura, please confirm capacity and org alignment.
3) Add an item to next week's leadership sync to discuss the compensation band calibration timeline so we have a clear process if we need to approve exceptions.

If there's no dissent by EOD today, I'll mark this as "No hire — closeout" and update the req in Greenhouse.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Engineering

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@gmail.com>, Sarah Meyer <sarah@talentscout.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Update on Req-142 (Senior ML Engineer)

Hi Olivia —

Thank you for interviewing with Redwood and for the time you spent with the team. After careful review the hiring committee has decided not to move forward with an offer for Req-142 at this time. This was a competitive pool and the committee concluded there were stronger matches for the production ML experience we need right now.

We were impressed by your strategic product thinking and your leadership in cross-team projects — we'd like to keep your profile active for future roles that better match your strengths. With your permission we will keep your application on file and reach out when an appropriate role opens.

If you'd like feedback from the interview panel, I'm happy to coordinate a short 20-minute call.

Thanks again and best wishes —
Aditya Rao
Talent Acquisition — Redwood Inference

--
